messages.content: 曼聯的球員名單是什麼？

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

message.reasoning: The user asks "曼聯的球員名單是什麼？" which means "What is the player list of Manchester United?" They want the roster. We can use the function to get top scorer but not entire roster. There's no function for roster. So we need to answer manually. Provide current squad list. Use knowledge cutoff 2024-06. Provide list of players as of 2024-06. Let's provide approximate list. Also mention that it's subject to change.
